brief.headline: Meta plans record equity raise to fund AI expansion
brief.detail: Meta is reportedly seeking a record $97.5 billion equity raise to fund its AI expansion, one of the largest such raises on record.

brief.headline: Anthropic files S-1 with $16.3B revenue, Nasdaq ticker ANT
brief.detail: Anthropic's S-1 filing shows $16.3 billion in revenue and a planned Nasdaq listing under ticker ANT, giving investors their first look at its financials.

brief.headline: SK Hynix Q3 profit beats expectations, boosts shareholder returns
brief.detail: SK Hynix's third-quarter profit beat expectations, and the chipmaker vowed $75 billion in shareholder returns, reflecting strong AI memory demand.

brief.headline: Coca-Cola raises earnings outlook despite weak North America demand
brief.detail: Coca-Cola raised its earnings outlook even as it sees lackluster demand in North America, with its stock up about 32% this year.

brief.headline: Ares Capital to buy Apollo's MFIC in $2.6B deal
brief.detail: Ares Capital agreed to buy Apollo's MFIC in a $2.6 billion deal, a significant consolidation move in the investment banking and deals space.
